summary: Retest of game chances persistence fix (Platform-aware kvStore in useGameSession.ts). FE-1 PASS (modal pops at 0/10). FE-2 partial PASS (claim grants 10/10 in UI). FE-3 FAILS (CRITICAL) — same regression as iteration_22: router.back + re-enter Higher-Lower shows 0/10 and modal re-pops. FE-4 FAILS (page reload also 0/10). FE-5 FAILS — window.localStorage has NO tm:game:hl / tm:game:memory / tm:game:math / tm:game:ttt key after grant. Memory Match retest blocked by FE-4 navigation state but same observation (no tm:game:memory key). Conclusion: the new kvStore web branch is still NOT being executed / NOT producing any setItem call.

integration_issues.issue: After session.grantChances() the in-memory state correctly updates (UI: Chances 10/10) but: (a) window.localStorage.setItem is NEVER called for 'tm:game:hl' — verified by monkey-patching window.localStorage.setItem before the grant click; the proxy captured 0 calls for any tm:game:* key. (b) NO '[useGameSession]' console.warn messages appear (the new warn branches in kvStore.setItem are not firing either). (c) Other code paths (tm_session_token, tm_device_id, tm_admob_settings_v1) DO write to localStorage successfully in the same page, so the browser layer is fine. (d) Direct localStorage.setItem from devtools succeeds. Net effect: persist useEffect either never fires OR Platform.OS !== 'web' in this Metro bundle and AsyncStorage.setItem silently no-ops without throwing (so the catch + warn never runs). Result: chances reset to 0 on every screen re-entry / reload — the user-reported bug is NOT fixed.

action_items: URGENT: Add an unconditional top-level log to kvStore.setItem and to the persist useEffect to confirm which path runs. Example: at module load do `console.log('[useGameSession] Platform.OS =', Platform.OS)`. At the top of the persist useEffect do `console.log('[useGameSession] persist tick', {storageKey, hydrated, chancesLeft, hasUnlocked})`. Inside kvStore.setItem add `console.log('[useGameSession] setItem path', Platform.OS, key)`. This will pinpoint whether (a) the effect doesn't fire, (b) Platform.OS isn't 'web', or (c) the web branch runs but localStorage write silently does nothing.

If Platform.OS resolves to something other than 'web' in this Metro/Expo SDK 54 web bundle, replace the check with a feature detection: `const isWeb = typeof window !== 'undefined' && !!window.localStorage;` Then always prefer localStorage when available. This is more robust than relying on Platform.OS.

If the persist useEffect itself isn't firing after grantChances, suspect the `firstWrite` ref — under React 18 StrictMode / Expo Router screen remount the ref might still be sticking on `true`. Replace the firstWrite-ref guard with comparing the current payload to a useRef of the last-persisted JSON string; only skip when they are equal. That also auto-handles hydration without a flag.

Add a one-shot synchronous write inside grantChances itself as a belt-and-braces guarantee: `kvStore.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify({chancesLeft: chancesPerAd, totalPlays, hasUnlocked: true}))` right after the setStates. State persistence then doesn't depend on a subsequent effect tick.

After fix, retest FE-3 (back + re-enter shows 9/10, no auto modal) and FE-4 (page reload preserves 9/10) and FE-5 (window.localStorage.getItem('tm:game:hl') returns JSON with chancesLeft:9, hasUnlocked:true). Apply identical verification to memory-match, math-sprint, tic-tac-toe.
critical_code_review_comments: useGameSession.ts:9-56 — The Platform.OS === 'web' gate is the single point of failure. If react-native-web resolves Platform.OS to 'web' as expected this should work, but evidence (0 setItem calls, 0 warnings) indicates the branch is not running. A feature-detection approach (`typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.localStorage`) is more reliable.

useGameSession.ts:128-140 — The firstWrite ref guard combined with the `if (!hydrated) return` gate is fragile: any spurious cleanup/remount could leave the ref in a state where the first real state change is also skipped. Recommend persisting on every diff vs last-persisted-JSON instead.

useGameSession.ts:33-37 — Good: AsyncStorage catch now logs a warning. But on web, react-native-async-storage 1.x without a registered web driver may resolve setItem to a noop that neither throws nor writes — this would explain absence of both warnings AND localStorage entries if Platform.OS detection is off.
Cosmetic carry-over from iteration_22: _layout.tsx still references non-existent routes (admin/game-limits, coin-mine, plinko, treasure-hunt). Console warnings persist; harmless but noisy.

rca_of_issue: Symptom unchanged from iteration_22: every entry to a game screen pops the rewarded ad again and chancesLeft displays 0/10 — saved chances are lost on navigation and reload. Confirmed mechanism in this run: (1) Direct window.localStorage.setItem('__diag_key', 'hello') works → browser storage is fine. (2) A proxy installed on window.localStorage.setItem recorded ZERO setItem calls during the entire grant → play → back flow for tm:game:* keys. (3) Console captured ZERO '[useGameSession]' warnings, so the new AsyncStorage catch path never fired either. (4) AuthContext successfully writes tm_session_token to localStorage in the same page, confirming general localStorage write capability. The new Platform.OS === 'web' branch in kvStore.setItem is therefore NOT being entered (otherwise step 2 would have captured at least one call), which means either (a) Platform.OS does not equal 'web' in this Metro bundle and the AsyncStorage.setItem call silently no-ops without throwing (no catch fires), or (b) the persist useEffect itself is not running after grantChances due to the firstWrite ref + hydration timing. Recommended next step: add unconditional console.log inside kvStore.setItem and inside the persist effect so the next test run can disambiguate (a) vs (b).
